card.name: Garbled bullet and fraction symbols
card.fires_on: Broken or unusual special characters standing in for bullets, fractions or list markers in drug-label text, often at the start of a list item or before a quantity. Also one non-Latin script letter inside a Punjabi word.

modes.label: Broken bullet or fraction symbol
modes.description: A garbled byte-like character that replaces a bullet, fraction or sub-list marker before a dose, step or condition.
